mentions.name: FitBee
mentions.description: A calorie and macro tracking app focused on food quality and speed. It aims to make logging food as frictionless as possible, since tracking happens multiple times a day, and is built entirely with Swift and SwiftUI.
mentions.problem: Food tracking is beneficial for health but has always been a pain to do, so the app reduces friction for logging food multiple times a day.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a calorie & macro tracker called FitBee [1]. Tracking my food has been tremendously helpful in terms of improving my health, but it's always been a  PITA. The focus of FitBee is food quality & speed.
